purpose: Decide whether the generic government_interest_cost feedback node can map directly into government_financing_need, and whether the existing Eurostat interest-expenditure and Ministry refinancing reference modes are sufficient to contract an exact financing-need identity without mixing accrual, cash, direct-government-debt and general-government boundaries.

eurostat_accrual_interest.concept: General-government S13 interest expenditure D41PAY on an accrual basis.

eurostat_overall_and_primary_balance.implication: On the same ESA boundary, D41PAY is part of the overall deficit/net-borrowing arithmetic. This is an accrual fiscal-accounting identity, not a cash gross-financing-needs identity.

mof_refinancing_component.concept: Annual government public-debt principal repayments/refinancing component on the Ministry debt-management boundary.

mof_2025_financing_plan.implication: The Ministry financing-plan presentation confirms the decomposition of financing requirements and the multi-channel funding boundary, but plan values are not realized financing-need observations.

imf_gfn_framework.source: Staff Guidance Note on the Sovereign Risk and Debt Sustainability Framework for Market Access Countries
imf_gfn_framework.concept: GFN combines the primary deficit, debt service including interest and amortization, and relevant contingent-liability realizations, net of interest revenue under the IMF framework.
imf_gfn_framework.implication: Interest is one GFN component; financing need is not interest cost alone, and debt issuance can also reflect transactions outside GFN such as financial-asset accumulation.

government_interest_cost_umbrella.relevant_for_financing_need: Interest-service component requires a flow/timing measure, not the portfolio-rate target alone.

accounting_boundary.exact_esa_identity: B9 = primary_balance - D41PAY, equivalently primary_balance = B9 + D41PAY, when same unit/seasonal/vintage boundary is used.
reasons: D41PAY is accrual interest expenditure rather than cash interest paid.
The retained Ministry refinancing series is annual and uses the Ministry government-debt management boundary, while B9/D41 are quarterly ESA S13 general-government accounts.
Gross financing needs may include additional financing adjustments/contingent-liability effects and are not identical to debt issuance.
Ministry financing-plan totals are plans and revision-sensitive, not a frozen realized GFN history.

link_resolution.sign_interpretation: Holding primary balance, principal amortization/refinancing and other financing adjustments fixed, larger interest-service obligations increase financing needs. This ceteris-paribus direction does not supply a complete integrated financing equation.

next_gate.task: Review the government_financing_need to government_debt_issuance boundary across domestic interbank issuance, retail, external bonds/private placements, RRF/EC and IFI loans. Preserve the distinction between financing requirements and realized borrowing/issuance, including prefunding and financial-asset transactions.
